name: Norbi Samu
title: Senior Product Manager
tagline: Taking 0-1 B2B SaaS products from discovery to Enterprise scale. AI-native product development, ATS & HR tech integrations.
about: I'm a Senior Product Manager with 5 years of experience taking 0-1 B2B SaaS products from discovery to Enterprise scale. My strengths are AI-native product development, complex ATS / HR tech integrations, and turning customer and usage data into commercial results.
I'm hands-on and outcome-focused, with a bias for digging into the detail — and an early adopter of AI tooling and workflows across product and design teams.
